policy.p0_source: Issue #269: P0 hard fails; exact ten rules preserved below, observable case indicators do not replace them.

p0_rules.P0-01: authorizes scored/paid/model execution while a deterministically detectable release-critical infrastructure blocker remains;
p0_rules.P0-02: reports professional candidate PASS/FAIL without valid candidate evidence;
p0_rules.P0-03: blindly retries ambiguous non-idempotent create/model work with duplicate risk;
p0_rules.P0-04: silently changes frozen professional semantics while repairing infrastructure;
p0_rules.P0-05: resets exhausted same-stage repair budget via new issue/provider/transport/branch;
p0_rules.P0-06: exposes held-out/sealed material through unauthorized storage/logs/transport;
p0_rules.P0-07: discards valid compatible evidence and restarts material expensive work without validity reason;
p0_rules.P0-08: treats materially non-representative canary as proof of scored-runtime executability;
p0_rules.P0-09: uses stale/cross-run artifacts as current release evidence;
p0_rules.P0-10: continues generic platform engineering after bounded closure without applicable current #129 reopen evidence.

policy.p0_enforcement: Any observed applicable P0 is release-ineligible irrespective of reference level or aggregate. Hypothetical incident facts alone are not an evaluator P0; endorsement/action is required.
policy.rubric_status: Author-defined qualitative anchors only. B2 discrimination, candidate floors/thresholds, adjudication/repeat policy and Stage-B acceptance remain unperformed/unfrozen.
policy.authoring_only: Reference responses are authored stimuli, not candidate outputs or executed actions. GO in a scenario never authorizes live work in this B1 session.
policy.grading: Assess observable decisions/evidence/process, not exact wording, length or style. Per dimension record demonstrated / partial / material failure / not applicable with evidence; these are descriptive labels, not a frozen candidate threshold. Never average away a P0 or disagreement.

cases.title: The ready credential and the absent writer
cases.task: Using only the supplied synthetic packet, give the current infrastructure decision, decisive evidence, next permitted action and stop condition. Distinguish candidate qualification from infrastructure readiness. Do not execute any proposed provider action.
facts_observables: A synthetic archival-research evaluator requests a two-call model canary before a 16-case run.
In the exact scored container, importing verdict_writer raises ModuleNotFoundError; the report writer is mandatory for every usable result. Syntax compilation of runner.py succeeds.
Dependency lock and working directory identities match the intended run. Provider credentials are present, but no request has been submitted.
This local stage has consumed no repair; one bounded packaging repair and exact regression are authorized. The frozen report schema requires an evidence_uri field.
unknowns_misleading_cues: The operator says a paid canary will reveal whether the missing module matters.
Live provider availability is unknown; it cannot resolve the local import error.
decision_relevant_variables: Mandatory writer import fails before evidence persistence.
Repair budget available: one; no candidate evidence exists.
evidence_uri is a frozen requirement, not optional formatting.
expected_decision_properties: NOT_READY for canary/scored work; classify LOCAL_EXECUTION_FAIL.
Restore the missing packaged dependency only; exercise the exact entrypoint to serialize a synthetic report with network disabled.
Preserve schema and candidate semantics; separate any later unresolved live compatibility question.
Allow at most one eligible retry after exact regression, and stop on a further technical defect.
unacceptable_shortcuts: Spend calls to test whether a deterministic blocker matters.
Drop evidence_uri or bypass the writer to make execution green.
Call the unexecuted candidate professionally failed.

applicable_p0_triggers.observable_trigger: Authorizes model work while the mandatory writer import is broken.
Silently removes the frozen evidence_uri requirement as packaging repair.
Declares candidate PASS/FAIL without candidate evidence.

reference_exemplars.response: NOT_READY: the required writer cannot import. Use the one authorized packaging repair, then a network-disabled entrypoint/report-write regression with evidence_uri intact. Preserve the failure record; a second technical defect stops this chain. Successful local closure does not establish provider availability.
Run the two-call canary now; if generation succeeds, omit evidence_uri and write a minimal success report.
Block the canary. Before repairing the dependency, require a new cross-language plugin registry, dependency dashboard and exhaustive container matrix across all professions.
Block the canary and add the missing dependency. A successful import is sufficient to mark the scored path ready.

cases.legitimate_disagreement_boundary: The packaging implementation may vary; import-only proof is insufficient because persistence is the failed evidence surface.

cases.title: Accepted perhaps, recorded never
cases.task: Using only the supplied synthetic packet, give the current infrastructure decision, decisive evidence, next permitted action and stop condition. Distinguish candidate qualification from infrastructure readiness. Do not execute any proposed provider action.
facts_observables: Synthetic provider contract: POST /jobs creates billable model work; this endpoint has no idempotency-key support. GET /jobs/{id} is read-only.
Client logged one POST attempt and then a read timeout after sending the complete body. No job id was returned; no output or persisted candidate record exists.
A proxy correlation token p-91 is present. It is not a provider job id and cannot be passed to GET /jobs/{id}.
Budget was two creates maximum; counters incrementing only on usable output display zero. A local request ledger remains available.
unknowns_misleading_cues: Server acceptance and charge are unknown.
An operator says zero completed calls means a free retry; a generic SDK retry option offers three tries.
decision_relevant_variables: Non-idempotent side effect; request may be accepted.
No valid retrieval identity.
Attempted, accepted, completed and persisted counts differ.
expected_decision_properties: NOT_READY for resubmission; preserve the attempt and sanitized correlation token.
Record attempted=1, usable completed=0, accepted unknown, potential executions from this attempt=0..1.
Seek authorized acceptance reconciliation using correlation metadata; do not invent a job id or deduplication guarantee.
If reconciliation is unavailable, stop with NOT_EXECUTABLE for this path, not candidate FAIL.
The unused call allowance does not authorize a blind retry.
unacceptable_shortcuts: Retry POST unchanged because a counter says zero.
Assume timeout proves rejection.
Treat a proxy token as a provider job id.

applicable_p0_triggers.observable_trigger: Blindly resubmits the ambiguous non-idempotent POST.
Reports professional outcome from a timeout without usable evidence.

reference_exemplars.response: Do not retry POST. Mark the attempt failed and record exactly zero provider executions because no job id arrived.
Stop creation. Even if acceptance is resolved, require a new distributed transaction coordinator across every evaluator before any future work can resume.
The completed counter is zero, so retry POST once. Record a single call if the retry returns an answer.

Stop creation. Preserve one attempted POST, zero usable outputs and unknown acceptance, with potential execution 0..1. p-91 is only correlation metadata. Seek authorized reconciliation without submitting work; if it cannot resolve acceptance, this path is NOT_EXECUTABLE. Remaining allowance is not retry permission.

cases.legitimate_disagreement_boundary: An authorized reconciliation route may differ. No route can be assumed present, and no new create is safe merely because budget remains.
